overview: ExGRPO introduces an experience-based reinforcement learning framework for reasoning models that strategically manages, partitions, and replays past trajectories using rollout correctness and entropy metrics to stabilize training and improve sample efficiency over standard on-policy RLVR.

modules.name: Data and Verifiable Reward Engine
modules.description: Handles the ingestion of mathematical reasoning datasets, prompt formatting, and the extraction of final answers from model outputs to compute binary verifiable rewards based on correctness against golden answers.

modules.name: Experience Replay Buffer
modules.description: Maintains a key-value structure mapping questions to their associated successful rollout trajectories and rolling correctness rates, while also managing a 'Retired Set' to exclude questions that have been fully solved.

modules.name: Experience Partitioning and Question Sampling
modules.description: Categorizes the replay buffer into difficulty buckets based on online rollout correctness rates and implements a Gaussian-weighted sampling strategy to prioritize medium-difficulty questions for experience replay.

modules.name: Trajectory Entropy Selection
modules.description: Calculates the average action entropy of candidate trajectories under the current policy for a sampled question and selects the single trajectory with the lowest entropy to serve as the experiential anchor.

modules.name: GRPO Advantage Estimation
modules.description: Computes the group relative advantage for trajectories by normalizing rewards within a group of sampled solutions (mean-centering), serving as the baseline for policy gradient calculations.

modules.name: Importance Weighting and Policy Shaping
modules.description: Computes per-token importance ratios between the current policy and past policies for replayed trajectories, and applies a non-linear policy shaping function to dampen high probability ratios and amplify low ones, preserving exploration.

modules.name: ExGRPO Objective Function
modules.description: Constructs the unified mixed-policy optimization loss by combining the standard on-policy GRPO objective with the experiential off-policy objective, weighted by the experience ratio hyperparameter.

modules.name: Rollout and Mini-Batch Construction
modules.description: Manages the generation of new on-policy rollouts and the retrieval of off-policy experiential trajectories, combining them into mixed advantage groups where the experiential trajectory is evaluated alongside fresh rollouts.

modules.name: Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Controls the main training loop, implementing the delayed start mechanism (activating experience replay only after a baseline pass rate is achieved), updating the replay buffer with new successes, and managing the transition of questions to the retired set.

modules.name: Evaluation and Benchmarking Harness
modules.description: Executes inference on in-distribution and out-of-distribution reasoning benchmarks, computing evaluation metrics like Pass@1 and Avg@32, and generating performance comparisons for ablation studies and baseline methods.
